header.statement: Each libFuzzer target of fuzz/CMakeLists.txt, under the heavy-job lock, with fuzz/launch.txt's flags and caps: first every input of the saved corpus and every seed the real encoders write, run once through the target's oracle, then merged into the smallest set that keeps their coverage, then a timed run of at least 1800 s that starts from that set; on Linux, each target whose decode reaches the AVX2 kernels or that verifies CRC32C, which runs the SSE4.2 kernel there, with the level set to avx2. Coverage, corpus and exec/s are the timed run's, libFuzzer's own final figures.

macOS.compile_flags: fuzz preset, RelWithDebInfo: -O2 -g -DNDEBUG -std=c++23 -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link,address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion, -DTICK_STORE_CRC32C_ARMV8 -DTICK_STORE_SIMD_NEON; targets linked with -Wl,-search_paths_first -Wl,-headerpad_max_install_names -nostdlib++ -Xlinker -exported_symbols_list -Xlinker build/fuzz/no-exported-symbols.txt -fsanitize=address,undefined -fuse-ld=lld -fsanitize=fuzzer
macOS.sanitizer_options: ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1:leak_check_at_exit=0:abort_on_error=0:exitcode=77 UBSAN_OPTIONS=print_stacktrace=1, from fuzz/launch.txt, which scripts/fuzz_g3.py applies
macOS.concurrency: four targets at once, unpinned, in four batches, each batch its own heavy.sh job; the Mac has 16 cores and other sessions' jobs may run beside it; ASAN_SYMBOLIZER_PATH set to the toolchain's llvm-symbolizer for every run, so a report never waits on the system's symbolizer
macOS.peak_memory: libFuzzer's peak_rss_mb, and BSD time -l per fuzzer: maximum resident set size and peak memory footprint

Linux.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen Embedded V1605B with Radeon Vega Gfx
Linux.compile_flags: fuzz preset, RelWithDebInfo: -O2 -g -DNDEBUG -std=c++23 -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link,address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion, -DTICK_STORE_CRC32C_SSE42 -DTICK_STORE_SIMD_AVX2; targets linked with -fsanitize=address,undefined -fsanitize=fuzzer
Linux.sanitizer_options: ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1:abort_on_error=0:exitcode=77 UBSAN_OPTIONS=print_stacktrace=1 TICK_STORE_SIMD=avx2, from fuzz/launch.txt, which scripts/fuzz_g3.py applies
Linux.concurrency: three targets at once, each pinned with taskset to one of cpu2, cpu6 and cpu7, in one heavy.sh job; cpu4 and cpu5 left alone, no measurement running
Linux.peak_memory: libFuzzer's peak_rss_mb, and the fuzzer's VmHWM read from the kernel's status file for the process every 5 s; this host has no GNU time
